coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of the 6 ground-truth variable categories (17%): the comparison of original time-attention SiT against non-causal Hyena SiT. The other categories do not match the specified experimental setup.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the pentapeptide MDGEN dataset (100k-frame, 10 ns trajectories) with synthetic signals and Lorenz-63, and substitutes its own training settings for Tables 2 and 4. Omits the 100 fs–100 ps lag range. Generic autocorrelation error on non-molecular sequences does not match torsional autocorrelation agreement with MD. It also omits dynamical content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation versus log-timescale, instead prioritizing PSD error.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that Hyena-augmented SiT should generate extremely long trajectories matching MD autocorrelation across timescales and capturing fast oscillations and slow relaxation in dynamical content, supporting consistent, physically plausible molecular simulations.
